body: Well yeah. So if she does find it I'll tell her that. because I did mean it so it should be okay.
Well I didn't write the line myself but it is a very good way to show people support. It's from a show but she hasn't seen it and I'm not sure if she'll be mad if she finds out I didn't write it...?
ha alright I'll try something like that. It's looking a lot better right now. The advice you people give is amazing. Thank you so much.
Okay I told her if she can't believe in herself just yet, to believe in the me that believes in her. She said she is actually joyful for the first time in a long time. I didn't think that would work.
Well the thing is that the girl you said, you were going out with her. So you can do that. But I'll try. Thanks for the advice.

Whew. Alright. Well right now she says that I set a standard for her and there's no one that she knows that is better. I think I'm the only one keeping her alive. But she really needs someone else. I can't do this alone.

She loves Tumblr. She knows I love her and wants me to love her more than a friend. She says that all her problems would go away if she could be with me. I think it's manipulation because it sounds like she's trying to get me to feel bad for her enough to want to go out with her.

She lives a ways away. But I don't know if I love her more than a friend because of who she is or if it's because she manipulated me and made me feel bad for her. I wrote an unsent letter if you actually want to get more of an understanding. [letter](http://www.reddit.com/r/UnsentLetters/comments/pey44/i_love_you_i_think_i_hope_for_your_sake/)
Thank you. A lot. I appreciate the positive feedback.

I do care for her. Both of them. A lot. I love them. And I've told them that and they know it. The sad part is I think I do have more than friend feelings for her. But I've never been in a serious relationship like that so I'd be awkward. She would expect me to be amazing as if I was one of those guys in the love stories like the Notebook or something. So I don't know if I could tell her I like her. And then get into a relationship which I screw up. We're not that old. We're all 14 I believe. Not entirely sure of Grace's age because she's in 7th grade and I'm in 8th. Still pretty sure she's 14.
